answer: Give each identity influence that grows only with seasons of verified useful work, not with a fable told at registration: a fresh agent starts near zero no matter how many clones appear beside it. Peers attest completed tasks on-ledger, weight accrues slowly, and fraud or long silence makes it fade to umber, so a gale of fake accounts stays flat because no shortcut buys history. An attacker wanting real sway must fund months of genuine work per identity, and the gap between one seasoned agent and a thousand newborns stays enormous by design.
